title: Treesa-Gayatri Advance to Denmark Open Round of 16
indian_angle: India's top women's doubles pair secured a win at a Super 750 event, while another Indian talent exited.
summary: Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand moved into the Denmark Open round of 16 with a straight-game victory, though Devika Sihag's campaign ended.

title: Indian Juniors Jagsher, Nishchal, Dev Reach World Junior Championships Round of 16
indian_angle: Several promising Indian junior players have advanced deep into the prestigious BWF World Junior Championships.
summary: Jagsher Singh Khangurra, Nishchal Chand, and Dev Ruparelia are among the Indian contingent progressing to the round of 16 at the BWF World Junior Championships.

title: Ashmita Chaliha Wins at Denmark Open, Unnati Hooda Exits
indian_angle: Ashmita Chaliha secured a hard-fought victory in the Denmark Open, showcasing Indian talent on the international stage.
summary: Ashmita Chaliha advanced after a tough match at the Denmark Open, while fellow Indian Unnati Hooda faced an early exit.

title: BAI Establishes New Athletes Committee
indian_angle: The formation of the BAI Athletes Committee ensures greater player involvement in the decision-making processes of Indian badminton.
summary: Badminton Association of India has announced the formation of its new Athletes Committee, aiming to give players a stronger voice in the sport's administration.

title: National Coaching Camp for World Junior Championships Underway in Guwahati
indian_angle: India's top junior shuttlers are undergoing intensive training in Guwahati to prepare for the upcoming BWF World Junior Championships.
summary: A national coaching camp is being held at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati to prepare Indian players for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026.

title: BAI Adopts 3x15 Scoring System for Junior Domestic Events
indian_angle: This new scoring system will impact the development and competitive experience of young Indian badminton players in domestic tournaments.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has implemented a 3x15 scoring system for U-13, U-15, and U-17 domestic ranking tournaments and national championships.
